To determine if you can apply for the Cybersecurity Research Scholarship (GR-CY-03), you must meet the following eligibility criteria:

*   **Academic Standing:** You must have a minimum CGPA of 8.0 on a 10-point scale [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].
*   **Year of Study:** You must be in Year 3 or Year 4 [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].
*   **Department:** You must be in the Computer Science & Engineering (CS) or Information Technology (IT) department [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].
*   **Financial Status:** You must have no overdue fee dues in the University fee ledger on the date of application [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].

Additionally, you must submit the following documents:
*   A research proposal (maximum 3 pages) [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].
*   Your latest grade card [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].
*   A no-dues certificate from Accounts [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §3].

Please note that this policy does not contain information regarding your current fee balance or the application deadline, as those are maintained in the University Grants Register [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §1].
